title: R2 fix: ECDSA g_crypto2dev_fd needs mutex for PK ops
description: crypto2dev_ecdsa() calls ioctl(g_crypto2dev_fd, CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_DO_SIGN/VERIFY) without holding any lock. Two threads can race: (1) concurrent SIGN/VERIFY on same fd, (2) cleanup() closing fd while ioctl is in progress. Fix: add wolfSSL mutex (wc_InitMutex/wc_LockMutex/wc_UnLockMutex) around the PK ioctl calls. Init in wc_crypto2dev_init(), free in wc_crypto2dev_cleanup().
